senses.gloss: m. (preced., v. קוֹרֶט) ḳaraṭ, a small coin.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:4:12">Y. Sot. III, 19ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:7:2">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="S01740"><he>קְפֵילִין</he></cite>.
Y. B. Mets. IV, beg. 9ᶜ ק׳ בק׳ שרי to lend money on ḳaraṭ against ḳ. (counting ḳaraṭs in place of denars) is permitted; cmp. לָקָן.—Pl. קְרָטִין.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 2:3:4">Y. Shek. II, 46ᵈ</cite> <he>ביקשו לשקול דינרין ק׳ וכ׳</he> ‘they wanted to pay their half-shekels in denars’ (Mish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 2:4">ib. II, 4</cite>), that is in ḳaraṭs, but it was not accepted.—<he>קֳרָטִים</he>, <he>קֳרָטִין</he>, v. <cite ref="S00591"><he>קוֹרֶט</he></cite>.
